request.label: outlet-qual-btip-pressure-diagnosis
command:
import inspect,json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
import physical_oracle as po
from resources import atomic
from task2_outlet_case import get_context
from task2_outlet_qualification import load_case
from task2s_local_audit import continuity,weak_traces
r=Path(sys.argv[1]); o=Path(sys.argv[2]); c=get_context(r); ref=po.load_reference(c[2])
old=po.require
def diagnose(condition,message):
    if condition or message != "open normal trace fails pressure level test":
        old(condition,message)
    else:
        v=inspect.currentframe().f_back.f_locals
        out=dict(pressure_action=v["max_action"], volume_minus_face=v["err"],
                 worst_dofs=[int(ids[abs(v["shift"][i,ids]-v["from_faces"][i,ids]).argmax()])
                              for i,ids in enumerate(v["state"].ufree)])
        atomic(o,out);print(out,flush=True)
        old(condition,message)
po.require=diagnose
s,_=load_case(r,"Btip",c,ref,24,time.monotonic()+44)
_,shift=continuity(s)
weak_traces(s,shift)

request.label: outlet-qual-btip-pressure-exact
command:
import sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from physical_oracle import load_reference
from resources import atomic,identity
from task2_outlet_baseline import read,require
from task2_outlet_case import get_context
from task2_outlet_qualification import load_case
from task2s_local_audit import continuity,weak_traces

root=Path(sys.argv[1])
old=root/"evidence/outlet-qual-btip-pressure-diagnosis.json"
context=get_context(root)
ref=load_reference(context[2])
states={}
for case in ("Bn2","Btip"):
    state,binding=load_case(root,case,context,ref,24,time.monotonic()+24)
    values,shift=continuity(state)
    t=weak_traces(state,shift)
    row=dict(provenance=binding,continuity=values,pressure_action=t["restricted_pressure_constant_action_MAX"],
         volume_minus_face=t["restricted_pressure_volume_minus_face_MAX"])
    require(max(row["volume_minus_face"])<1e-11 and row["pressure_action"][0]>1e-6,
            "closed-form pressure action does not meet the same proof gate")
    states[case]=row
require(read(old)["volume_minus_face"][0]>1e-11,"expected a reproduced narrow-cell quadrature discrepancy")
atomic(root/"evidence/outlet-qual-btip-pressure-exact.json",dict(
    schema="WJH27TerminalPressureProofV1",method="Exact signed tensor cell derivative moments",
    prior_failure=identity(old),cases=states))
print({c:(r["pressure_action"],r["volume_minus_face"]) for c,r in states.items()},flush=True)
